title: 2005 AMC 12B Problem 4
statement: At the beginning of the school year, Lisa’s goal was to earn an A on at least \(80\%\) of her \(50\) quizzes for the year. She earned an A on \(22\) of the first \(30\) quizzes. If she is to achieve her goal, on at most how many of the remaining quizzes can she earn a grade lower than an A?

solutions.text:
Lisa needs an A on at least \(0.8 \cdot 50 = 40\) quizzes.

She has \(22\) already, so she needs \(40 - 22 = 18\) more of the remaining \(20\) quizzes.

She can earn a lower grade on at most \(20 - 18 = 2\) of them.

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: \(80\%\) of \(50\) quizzes is the number of A’s she needs
She needs \(40 - 22\) more A’s out of the remaining \(20\) quizzes
